title: A Gravity for the Protocol
author: Sable Brightwater
blurb: Mirabel Thackeray, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
